name: daintree-decisions
description: Daintree Decisions: a non-blocking, end-to-end encrypted human-in-the-loop relay for AI coding agents. Self-hosted on Cloudflare.

CLAIM_SECRET.description: One-time setup secret that lets *you* (and nobody else) claim this deployment for your Daintree installation. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and keep it: Daintree asks for it once during setup.

XAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. xAI API key for Grok dictation on the phone. Leave blank to disable cloud dictation.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Anthropic API key for Claude Haiku dictation clean-up. Leave blank to disable.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAI API key for the single-provider dictation mode. Leave blank to disable.
